## About

Islam.wiki provides authentic Islamic scholarship in an accessible, searchable format. All content follows Ahl us-Sunnah wal-Jamaah methodology with verified sources and scholarly consensus.

The platform includes:

- Full Quran with Arabic, multiple translations, and tafsir (Ibn Kathir, Al-Jalalayn)
- All major Hadith collections (Bukhari, Muslim, Abu Dawud, Tirmidhi, Nasai, Ibn Majah, Muwatta, Musnad Ahmad, and more) with grading and isnad visualization
- Classical Islamic books and scholarly works
- 1,075+ scholar biographies covering Sahabah, Tabi'un, and Tabi' al-Tabi'in
- Seerah timeline with interactive map
- Encyclopedic articles on Islamic topics, sects, and historical events

## Content scope

| Section | Coverage |
| --- | --- |
| Quran | 114 surahs, 6,236 ayahs, Arabic + translations + tafsir |
| Hadith | 70,000+ hadith across 10+ collections |

| Seerah | Full timeline with place coordinates |
